name: Fujikawa Maru

sources.title: Fujikawa Maru — Mitsubishi 1938, 6,938 GRT, aircraft transport; 6-inch bow gun; sunk in Operation Hailstone, 17 February 1944
Liveaboard.com — Fujikawa Maru: upright on the bottom, from about 5 to 37 m, Zero fighters and aircraft parts in a hold
DAN Alert Diver — 66 Years Down: into hold 2 to see the Zero fighters
NPS — War in the Pacific: depths of the Truk Lagoon wrecks (Fujikawa Maru 12-35 m)

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1473175_fujikawa_maru.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upright at about 34 m; the two masts still standing (tops a few metres under the surface), the bridge and accommodation island, the funnel gone to a stump, the hatches open; the 6-inch gun on the forecastle and another on the poop; Zero fuselages, drop tanks and wing parts in hold 2, drums and crates in the other holds; a torpedo hole on the starboard side aft. Heading (not published: 0), the layout of the holds and superstructure, the place of the cargo and of the hole are approximate. model_built.glb: the ship as she sailed in 1943-44. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
